ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached circuit is an R-2R ladder DAC. A reference voltage V_R is applied at the left. Along the top rail there are three series resistors labeled R, followed by a final horizontal resistor labeled 2R to ground on the far right. Several vertical branches labeled 2R go downward either to ground symbols or to the op-amp inverting-input summing node. The op-amp non-inverting input is grounded, and the op-amp has a feedback resistor R, so the inverting node is a virtual ground. The current i is labeled on the top rail at the node just before the final horizontal 2R resistor, directed toward that 2R resistor. Reasoning: Since the op-amp non-inverting input is grounded and negative feedback is present, the inverting input is at virtual ground. Thus the lower ends of ladder branches connected to the op-amp summing node are effectively at 0 V, just like the branches connected to ground symbols. Starting from the rightmost marked node where i is measured, there are two 2R paths to 0 V: the vertical 2R branch and the final horizontal 2R branch. Their equivalent is 2R || 2R = R. Moving leftward, each previous ladder section sees the same equivalent termination R, so each series R stage forms a 1:1 divider with an equivalent R to ground. There are three such series R stages from V_R to the marked node, so the marked-node voltage is V_R/2^3 = V_R/8 = 10/8 = 1.25 V. The current through the final horizontal 2R resistor is therefore i = V_node/(2R) = 1.25 V / (20 kΩ) = 62.5 μA.

method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个 R-2R 梯形 Digital-to-Analog converter 电路。左端为参考电压 V_R，顶部有三个串联的 R 电阻形成梯形主干；各节点有 2R 支路向下，其中部分直接接地，部分接到运放反相输入端。运放同相输入端接地，并且有反馈电阻 R，所以反相输入端可按虚地处理。最右端节点通过一个标为 2R 的电阻接地，电流 i 标在该右端 2R 支路方向上。

再推理：把运放反相求和节点用虚地规则等效为地。令三个串联 R 后的顶部节点电压分别为 V1、V2、V3，其中 V3 是给右端标记电流 i 的节点。左端源节点固定为 V_R = 10 V。

在 V3 节点列 KCL：
(V3 - V2)/R + V3/(2R) + V3/(2R) = 0
化简得 2V3 - V2 = 0，即 V2 = 2V3。

在 V2 节点列 KCL：
(V2 - V1)/R + (V2 - V3)/R + V2/(2R) = 0
化简得 2.5V2 - V1 - V3 = 0。

在 V1 节点列 KCL：
(V1 - V_R)/R + (V1 - V2)/R + V1/(2R) = 0
化简得 2.5V1 - V2 - V_R = 0。

由 V2 = 2V3，代入 V2 方程：2.5(2V3) - V1 - V3 = 0，所以 V1 = 4V3。再代入 V1 方程：2.5(4V3) - 2V3 - 10 = 0，即 8V3 = 10，因此 V3 = 1.25 V。

右端电流 i 通过 2R 电阻接地，所以 i = V3/(2R)。已知 R = 10 kΩ，因此 2R = 20 kΩ，i = 1.25 V / 20 kΩ = 62.5 μA。
